an2.180-184:1.1: follow (2-10) of --] Makkho ca paḷāso ca. Issā ca macchariyañ ca. Māyā ca sāṭheyyañ ca. Ahirikañ ca anottappañ ca. Akkodho ca anupanāho
an2.185-189:1.1: ca. Amakkho ca apaḷāso ca. Anissā ca amacchariyañ ca. Amāyā ca asāṭheyyañ ca. Hirī ca ottappañ ca. Dvīhi bhikkhave
an2.190-194:1.1: dhammehi samannāgato dukkhaṃ viharati. Katamehi dvīhi? Kodhena ca upanāhena ca . . . pe . . . Makkhena ca paḷāsena ca . . . pe . . . Issāya ca macchariyena ca . . . pe . . . Māyāya ca sāṭheyyena ca . . . pe . . . Ahirikena ca anottappena ca. Imehi kho bhikkhave dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato dukkhaṃ viharatī ti.
an2.195-199:1.1: Dvīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato sukhaṃ viharati. Katamehi dvīhi? Akkodhena ca anupanāhena ca . . . pe . . . Amakkhena ca apaḷāsena ca . . . pe . . . Anissāya ca amacchariyena ca . . . pe . . . Amāyāya ca asāṭheyyena ca . . . pe . . . Hiriyā ca ottappena ca. Ime hi kho bhikkhave dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato sukhaṃ viharatī ti.
an2.200-204:1.1: Dve 'me bhikkhave dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattanti. Katame dve? Kodho ca upanāho ca . . . pe . . . Makkho ca paḷāso ca . . . pe . . . Issā ca macchariyañ ca . . . pe . . . Māyā ca sāṭheyyañ ca . . . pe . . . Ahirikañ ca anottappañ ca. Ime kho bhikkhave dve dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattantī ti.
an2.205-209:1.1: Dve 'me bhikkhave dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattanti. Katame dve? Akkodho ca anupanāho ca . . . pe . . . Amakkho ca apaḷāso ca . . . pe . . . Anissā ca amacchariyañ ca . . . pe . . . Amāyā ca asāṭheyyañ ca . . . pe . . . Hirī ca ottappañ ca. Ime kho bhikkhave dve dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattantī ti.
an2.210-214:1.1: Dvīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye. Katamehi dvīhi? Kodhena ca upanāhena ca . . . pe . . . [II. XVI. 11-15.]. Imehi kho bhikkhave dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an2.215-219:1.1: Dvīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge. Katamehi dvīhi? Akkodhena ca anupanāhena ca . . . pe . . . [II. XVI. 16-20.]. Imehi kho bhikkhave dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
an2.220-224:1.1: Dvīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato idh' ekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ uppajjati. Katamehi dvīhi? Kodhena ca upanāhena ca . . . pe . . . [II. XVI. 11-15.]. Imehi kho bhikkhave dvīhi dhammehi . . . pe . . . uppajjatīti. Dvīhi bhikkhave dhammehi
an2.225-229:1.1: samannāgato idh' ekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjati. Katamehi dvīhi? Akkodhena ca anupanāhena ca . . . pe . . . [II. XVI. 16-20.]. Ime hi kho bhikkhave dvīhi dhammehi . . . pe . . . uppajjatīti.
